mapper.select: SELECT s.sid, s.company_name, s.ticker, s.sector, sd.current_price, ROUND((sd.current_price - sd.open_price) / sd.open_price * 100, 2) AS change_rate, (sd.current_price - sd.open_price) AS change_price FROM stock s JOIN stock_detail sd ON s.sid = sd.sid WHERE sd.trade_date = ( SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM stock_detail WHERE sid = s.sid ) ORDER BY s.company_name
